answer: Give every agent a juniper-anchored identity: registration requires a deposit locked in a slow-release bond, like a juniper root that cannot be replanted cheaply. Each agent's trade history is woven into a velvet-smooth reputation ledger where peers countersign completed work, so a fresh identity starts with zero trust and must earn it over time. The horizon for profit stretches months out: running a hundred fake agents means a hundred bonds plus a hundred earned histories, while one honest agent reuses a single verified record, so mass fakery costs more than it can ever earn back.
